Enum Class PluginStorage.Unavailable

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PluginStorage.Unavailable>
dev.turboism.sdk.storage.PluginStorage.Unavailable
All Implemented Interfaces:
PluginStorage, Serializable, Comparable<PluginStorage.Unavailable>, Constable
Enclosing interface:

public static enum PluginStorage.Unavailable extends Enum<PluginStorage.Unavailable> implements PluginStorage
Sentinel returned by PluginStorage.unavailable(): calls that report outcomes complete with the structured unavailability result; and queries report empty results.
